entry_text: The merge worker retries a failed rebase three times before parking the task.
target_text: Pyright runs only for packages with staged Python changes in the pre-commit hook.

entry_text: FalkorDB renders a scalar count as a bare number on its own line in redis-cli output.
target_text: The dashboard groups escalations by task id and sorts them by filing time.

entry_text: The scheduler's claim lease is now 900 seconds; the old 300-second lease was raised in task 9001.
target_text: The scheduler's claim lease is 300 seconds and expires if the agent stops heartbeating.

entry_text: Running uv sync inside a worktree no longer reuses the main checkout's venv; each worktree gets its own.
target_text: A task worktree shares the main checkout's .venv, so uv sync there is unnecessary.

entry_text: Never run git stash in any checkout: refs/stash is shared by every worktree.
target_text: git stash is unsafe here because the stash stack is one ref shared across all worktrees.

entry_text: ruff check is the lint gate; ruff format is not adopted, and a format-only diff should not be filed as cleanup.
target_text: This repo uses ruff check only; ruff format is deliberately not adopted.

entry_text: Bash cwd persists between calls, so anchor ad-hoc probes on git rev-parse --show-toplevel.
target_text: Agent shell gotchas: cwd persists across calls, VIRTUAL_ENV is inherited from main, and foreground sleep is blocked.

entry_text: Verify strips VIRTUAL_ENV before spawning the target's commands.
target_text: Agents inherit VIRTUAL_ENV from the main checkout in their own Bash sessions.

entry_text: The ledger keeps an undo-capable journal of every heal write.
Escalations filed under one anchor fold into the open record for that anchor.
target_text: A folded escalation anchor must be registered in the no-two-filers test.
